title: Active Aerogels
content: Active Aerogels is a Portuguese company focused on the development and commercialization of aerogel-based thermal insulation products. The company produces high-performance aerogel blankets and boards designed for industrial applications, including oil and gas, petrochemical, and building insulation. Active Aerogels leverages advanced sol-gel technology to produce aerogels with ultra-low thermal conductivity, excellent hydrophobicity, and long-term durability. Their products are designed to meet the demanding requirements of industrial insulation while reducing energy consumption and carbon emissions.
